description: Recorded real GDACS data. Earthquake files hold the JSON of the named public GDACS API responses, parsed and re-serialised with json.dumps (JSON-equal to the response bodies, not byte-identical); tropical cyclone timelines keep, unedited, the named fields of every track point of the response. Nothing is synthetic.
source: Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System (EC Joint Research Centre / UN OCHA), https://www.gdacs.org. Content (c) European Union, reused under CC BY 4.0 (https://commission.europa.eu/legal-notice_en#copyright-notice).
selection: Earthquakes: the first 15 Red, 15 Orange and 8 Green events of GDACS's event lists for 2023-01-01 to 2026-10-01 (geteventlist/SEARCH?eventlist=EQ&alertlevel=<level>, recorded 2026-10-19). 30 of the 38 list a 'shakemap' impact; 26 are included. The other four (Red 1474477, 1548377, 1548473; Orange 1511252) could not be recorded: GDACS reset the connection or timed out on every attempt. Tropical cyclones: one Red (MELISSA-25, latest episode and episode 12), one Red JTWC (CHAMPI-26), two Orange (DITWAH-25, TAPAH-25) and one Green (CHOI-WAN-26) event, 152 track points.
content: eq_event_<id>.json: GDACS event details (country, affected countries, alert level and score). eq_shakemap_alert_<id>.json: GDACS shakemap impact model output, whose 'Alert Parameters' datum carries AlertLevel, AlertScore, ScaledPopulation (log10), CoeffIntersept, CoeffSlope, CountryVuln, LccNormalised and MaxMMI, and whose 'Pop' datum carries population by MMI band (ep3..ep9).
notes: Used by tests/infrastructure/humanitarian/test_gdacs.py to check the module against GDACS's own scores. GDACS's CountryVuln field reads 0 even where its score applies the 2017 table's country vulnerability. The tropical cyclone timelines check the GDACS MHEWS user manual's Table 1 (JRC141661, 2025; version of 23/09/2026) per track point.

tc_timeline_1001230.json.method: GET; from the verbatim response, the listed fields of every channel.item are kept unedited and the rest (geometry, wind radii) dropped for size
tc_timeline_1001230.json.content: GDACS tropical cyclone track timeline for event 1001230 (MELISSA-25; the timeline's storm_name is empty): 48 track points with 1-min sustained wind (m/s), population in the 34 kt (pop39) and 64 kt (pop74) buffers, point country, GDACS's alert colour and whether it was decreased.
